display_name: Superior Attuned Superior Overpowering Presence D
help: UNIQUE -- No more than 1 enhancement of this type may be slotted by a character.  Enhances the accuracy of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Accuracy.Scale}%, enhances the hold duration of a power by {Boost.Attrib.Hold.Scale}%, the hold duration by {Boost.Attrib.Stun.Scale}%, the immobilization duration by {Boost.Attrib.Immobilize.Scale}%, the sleep duration by {Boost.Attrib.Sleep.Scale}%, the fear duration by {Boost.Attrib.Terrorized.Scale}% and the confuse duration by {Boost.Attrib.Confused.Scale}% and reduces endurance cost by {Boost.Attrib.Endurance.Scale}%.  This enhancement can only be slotted by Controllers and may be slotted into most control powers and requires the user to be level 50.
power_display_names: (Controller) Superior Overpowering Presence Presence: Accuracy/Control Duration/Endurance
power_short_helps: Enhances Accuracy, Control Duration, and Reduces Endurance Cost
